text:
Kathy owns the Miami condominium outright by survivorship under the tenancy by the entirety created when Bill signed and delivered the deed, so that property passes outside the probate estate. Tommy takes the Deerwoods pasture land under the will, and Tommy and Julie share all remaining assets equally. Kathy’s valid prenuptial agreement waives her pretermitted-spouse, elective-share, and homestead rights, so she receives nothing further from the estate.
CONFIDENCE: 87
